head_commit.message:
Integrate complete nominal lowering and repair exact cold source custody

Merge main 5831f52 with the native request, journal and immutable installer continuation. Refresh coverage and source pins in dependency order after the exact 6994512 source job failed. Remove unused compiler CFG construction in the names oracle without changing its 106 cases, 40 refusals or 154 public assembly calls.

Retain both original 6994512 cold timeouts, prior failures, independent source observations, and desktop prerequisite receipts. Preserve the 180-second deadline, two cold workers, all 38 phases, fixed points and downstream suites. No complete native delivery, new-source qualification or deployed activation is claimed.
